h2: Pool Cleaning Denpasar – One-Off Service for Villas & Homes
intro: Looking for Pool Cleaning Denpasar that gets the job done in a single visit? Bali Fix covers skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and full water-balance correction for family houses, shop-houses and villa pools across the city. Whether your pool has gone green during a PDAM supply drop or you need it spotless before guests arrive, send us photos on WhatsApp and we will sort it out.

sections.h3: Why Pools Go Green Faster in City Neighbourhoods
sections.text: Renon and Sidakarya sit close to busy roads and ongoing construction, so fine dust settles on pool surfaces within days. Add periodic PDAM mains drops—when float valves top up from tanks with slightly different mineral content—and algae finds an easy foothold. Tight lanes also mean fewer people notice a slow colour shift until the water is visibly murky. A one-off deep clean plus a proper filter backwash usually brings things back without needing a full chemical reset.

sections.h3: What a One-Off Clean Actually Involves
sections.text: Every visit follows the same sequence: skim leaves and debris, brush walls and floor to lift biofilm, vacuum the basin, then backwash the sand or cartridge filter so it is not just pushing dirty water around. We test pH, chlorine and alkalinity, adjusting as needed. For green-pool recoveries we may run two passes—shock treatment first, then a clean once the water clears. Waterline tiles get a dedicated scrub because that band collects calcium and algae fastest.

sections.h3: Sending Photos on WhatsApp for a Quick Quote
sections.text: Snap three shots from your phone: one wide view of the whole pool showing the water colour, one close-up of the waterline tiles, and one of the pump/filter area if visible. Drop them in a WhatsApp message along with your street name and whether this is a routine refresh or a full green-water rescue. Cost depends on the job; we will look at the photos and give you a straight figure before anyone picks up a brush.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Pool Clear Between Visits
sections.text: A few habits save money here. Keep the pool cover on during heavy-rain days when city drains backflow into low-lying streets and splash muddy water onto the basin. After any PDAM supply drop, run the filter an extra hour so the tank top-up does not leave a mineral film behind. In dusty months, skim daily instead of letting debris sink and break down. If the water looks even slightly hazy after two or three days, a quick brush-and-vacuum now saves a full green-pool recovery later.

faq.q: How much does one-off pool cleaning cost in Denpasar?
faq.a: It depends on the job—a routine refresh versus a green-water recovery are very different. Send photos on WhatsApp and we will give you a clear figure before starting.

faq.q: Can you handle a fully green pool in one visit?
faq.a: Often yes, but sometimes we need a shock-treatment pass first and then come back to vacuum once the water clears. We will tell you which scenario applies after seeing your photos.

faq.q: Do you service pools in shop-houses and offices as well as villas?
faq.a: Yes. Family houses, shop-house terraces and office courtyard pools all get the same skimming, brushing, vacuuming and filter-backwash routine. Just let us know the access situation when you message on WhatsApp.
